name: Men's Aviator Shirt Uniform: white long-sleeve aviator shirt, gray trousers
size_basis: Silhouette traced from images/base/aviator_shirt_male.webp (581x719 px; the female outline is traced from the clean 1130x1392 re-render of the same drawing) at 0.0376 in per 581-px-canvas px, chosen so the shirt is the same body width as the Class B shirt (20.8 in sleeve to sleeve before the sleeves were widened). The two sleeves are then widened outward by up to 1.5 in (smooth ramp from the shoulder end at 3.6 in to full at 7.5 in below the top, body side untouched) so the regulation 3 1/2 in chevron sits on the sleeve: the hanging view traced here is only 2.95 in wide at the chevron line. The widening is an estimate (the regulation gives no sleeve width). No real garment was measured.
landmarks_note: rects are {x,y,w,h}; polygons are [[x,y]...]; user units (0.01 in), origin top-left

sleeve_widening.note: outward warp of the traced sleeve (outline and every stroke in it) so the 3 1/2 in regulation chevron (4.2.5.1.1.3 / 4.2.6.2.3) lies inside the sleeve outline instead of 0.27 in (men) / 0.31 in (women) off the garment; the pre-widening flat sleeve was 2.95 in (men) / 3.5 in (women) at the chevron line

documented: white aviator-style shirt, two standard sewn flap pockets, curved flap bottom allowed, straight collar, two epaulet straps (CAPR 39-1 4.2.5.1 / 4.2.6.1.1)
nametag centred on, resting on (not over) the edge of the pocket on the wearer's right (4.2.5.1.2.1 / 4.2.6.2.6.1.1)
ribbons centred on, resting on the edge of the wearer's left pocket (4.2.5.1.2.2)
cadet NCOs/airmen: metal chevrons on both sides of the collar, 1 in from and parallel to the front of the collar; cadet officers: blue epaulet sleeves
medium gray trousers, plain black belt with silver buckle (4.2.5.1.5-.6)
assumed: sleeve widening (outward warp of the traced sleeve, see dimensions.sleeve_widening)
epaulet strap size (not drawn in the base image)
gray shade and belt colours sampled from the base image
